pstack-verifier: PASS+NOTES @ 6e644f792255edb5802a157a8e5a7fbe789d6d2a

Verified by DeepSeek (deepseek-flash), a different model family from the author, on a GitHub-hosted runner. It read the diff and text evidence only, never screenshots.

The diff adds a snippet store with unit tests and wires a Snippets section, save/tap-to-fill/delete actions and a fading Saved note into the reader's plus menu, and the head build plus the native-skills journey pass; but no journey exercised any snippet flow, so the promised outcomes are only shown by code reading.

Journeys driven (parent is the app before this change, head is after):
- `native-skills.md` parent: passed, head: passed

Evidence:
- native-skills.md passed on both parent and head, so the added Snippets row and the new KitMenu footer parameter did not break the existing plus menu or model/effort menus it exercises.
- native-skills.md artifacts (08-native-plus-menu, 09-native-plus-same-list, 11-native-model-menu) are the only menu evidence, and they contain no Snippets page, save, fill, delete or Saved-note step.
- MultipromptApp.kt wires Save current text to Snippets.add/snippetStore.write, tap to setPrompt plus closing the sheet, and a red Delete to Snippets.delete/snippetStore.write, matching the description.
- SnippetStore.kt stores snippets in a private 'snippets' SharedPreferences file, matching 'stay on this phone only', and SnippetStoreTest.kt covers empty text, duplicates, truncation, naming, delete, cap and JSON round-trip.
- DesignKit.kt KitSavedNote fades 1 -> 0.65 -> 0.3 -> 0 over about 2 seconds then calls onFinished, matching 'fades after about two seconds'.
- The empty state text 'No snippets yet' is present in the Snippets section for an empty list.
- Head side app-apk-sha256.txt and app-source-sha.txt show the head revision c92f996 was built and run for the journey, so the new code compiled.

Not covered:
- Opening the Snippets page from the plus menu and the back behaviour
- Saving the current message text and seeing it appear in the list
- Tapping a snippet to fill the message box and return to the chat
- Deleting a snippet with the red Delete
- The empty 'No snippets yet' state on a real device
- The Saved note appearing and fading after about two seconds

Run: https://github.com/valentinyeo/multiprompt-android/actions/runs/43838997475

pstack-verifier: FAIL @ 9b76ef410563d86907ef6d85c4fa840e7d07bd35

Verified by DeepSeek (deepseek-flash), a different model family from the author, on a GitHub-hosted runner. It read the diff and text evidence only, never screenshots.

The only Snippets entry row is nested inside the PI-only Model submenu (`else if (piModelMenu)`), so the plus menu itself does not get the promised Snippets row and non-PI agents cannot reach the feature. The two driven journeys pass on both parent and head but exercise unrelated native-skills and session-reader flows, so they neither show nor contradict snippets.

Journeys driven (parent is the app before this change, head is after):
- `native-skills.md` parent: passed, head: passed
- `session-reader.md` parent: passed, head: passed

Evidence:
- diff (MultipromptApp.kt): the added `KitMenuRow(label = "Snippets", trailingText = "›", ...)` is inside the `} else if (piModelMenu) {` block, before the PI effort row.
- diff (MultipromptApp.kt): `piModelMenu` is defined as `session.agent == AgentKind.PI && attachMenuSection == PiModels.SECTION`, so the new row only renders in that submenu.
- diff (MultipromptApp.kt): the `attachMenuSection == "Snippets"` screen is not agent-gated, which shows it was intended to be reachable from the main plus menu for all agents.
- native-skills.md: head and parent both passed; its screenshots cover the plus menu, model, and effort, but no Snippets row or snippet action.
- session-reader.md: head and parent both passed with the same attach-menu and send/interrupt screenshots; no snippets step.
- diff (MultipromptApp.kt): the section back row sets `attachMenuSection = null`, so entering Snippets from the Model page would return to the root rather than to Model.

Not covered:
- Opening the plus menu and tapping a Snippets row
- Saving current text and seeing the Saved note fade
- Tapping a snippet to fill the message box and return to the chat
- Deleting a snippet and the empty-state line
- Snippets persisting across app restarts
- The plus menu for a non-PI agent, where the new row does not appear in the diff

Run: https://github.com/valentinyeo/multiprompt-android/actions/runs/43766167340
